title: Oven Roasted Brazilian Parma Ham Skewers
description: A charred, crispy, comforting Brazilian dish featuring Parma ham, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion, and is satvik-friendly as it does not contain onions or garlic, and the ingredients are sashimi-cut for a delicate presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread a piece of Parma ham, a pineapple chunk, a bell pepper piece, a zucchini slice, and a cherry tomato onto each skewer.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the skewers and season with salt and black pepper.
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the Parma ham is crispy and charred.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
